name: 駅前
description: The square in front of a small train station. The station building has a big clock on its tower and a blue sign. A woman in a beige coat is walking out of the station, pulling a pink suitcase. A man in a dark suit is waiting at the bus stop and looking at his phone. A yellow taxi is waiting on the road next to a crosswalk. There is a clock on a pole in the square, a red vending machine, a blue bicycle, trees in round planters, flower beds, and street lamps.
elements: a station building with a clock on the tower
a man looking at his phone at the bus stop
a yellow taxi on the road
trees and flower beds in the square
